stock.description: Robosense Technology Co., Ltd, an investment holding company, provides LiDAR and perception solutions in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company offers LiDAR products for advanced driver assistance systems, robotics, cleaning, industrial, logistics, public services, inspection, and other applications. It also provides LiDAR perception solutions consisting of P6, an automotive-grade solid-state LiDAR L4 sensor fusion solution; V2X, a vehicle-to-road synergistic perception system; Reference solution, a ground truth system for ADAS applications; HyperVision 1.0, an artificial intelligence perception software; and AC1, a robotic vision product. In addition, the company offers technology development and marketing services. Robosense Technology Co., Ltd was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, the People's Republic of China.
